passwordReset.subject: Reset your PetTemplate password
passwordReset.body:
Hello!

To set a new password, follow the link:
{link}

The link works for {hours} h and only once.

If you did not ask for a reset, just ignore this email.

emailConfirm.subject: Confirm your email in PetTemplate
emailConfirm.body:
Hello!

To confirm this address in your PetTemplate account, follow the link:
{link}

The link works for {hours} h. A confirmed email helps you restore a forgotten password.

If you did not add this email, just ignore this message.

emailChanged.subject: The email in your PetTemplate account was changed
